'''Indigo Speeder Squad''' was a unit of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] combat [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. They were part of the Republic force deployed to [[Raid on Saarn|face]] [[Thrawn's confederation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saarn]]. Two [[Arrow-23 landspeeder/Legends|Arrow-23 landspeeders]] were designated [[Indigo One|Indigos One]] and [[Indigo Two|Two]], and two [[XP-38 sport landspeeder]]s designated [[Indigo Three|Indigos Three]] and [[Indigo Four|Four]].
